This is a reusable package for doing Veracode static scans as part of our GitOps CI/CD processes.

# Using in pipeline definitions

We give instructions for how to include the scans in your GitLab pipelines. If you're using the
QuickStart Application, you already have this. Otherwise, here's how you integrate it into your
pipeline. Note that regardless, you need to set the pipeline variables listed in the section below.

## Using in GitLab (.gitlab-ci.yml)

Add the `sync-jiras` job to your .gitlab-ci.yml. First, add a stage at the beginning, before the deploy to
the fixed `dev` environment:

```
  - sync-jiras
```

Then add the following jobs (`mr-sast-scan`, `main-sast-scan`, `mr-sca-scan`, `main-sca-scan`, and `sync-jiras`) to the pipeline:

```
# Do SAST pipeline scan in Veracode. Don't include job dependencies here,
# and run on both MRs and branch pipelines. For more information:
# https://powerschoolgroup.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PSSec/pages/390627872/Procedure+-+Setup+Gitlab+Pipeline+to+Call+Veracode+Pipeline+Scans
.sast-scan:
  stage: test
  extends: .buildjob
  image: docker.io/veracode/pipeline-scan
  variables:
    BUILD_LOG: scan.log
  script:
    - . ./node_modules/@ps-refarch/veracode-static/scripts/veracode-scan.sh -r | tee ${BUILD_LOG}
  artifacts:
    name: scan-results
    # Get artifacts even on failure
    when: always
    paths:
      - veracode-scan/
    expire_in: 2 week

main-sast-scan:
  extends: .sast-scan
  except:
    - merge_requests

mr-sast-scan:
  extends: .sast-scan
  only:
    - merge_requests

.sca-scan:
  stage: test
  image: "alpine:3"
  tags:
    - uce-std
  variables:
    BUILD_LOG: scan.log
  script:
    - apk add curl
    - curl -sSL https://www.sourceclear.com/install | sh
    - sh ./node_modules/@ps-refarch/veracode-static/scripts/veracode-sca-scan.sh | tee ${BUILD_LOG}
  artifacts:
    name: scan-logs
    when: always
    paths:
      - veracode-scan/scan.log
    expire_in: 2 week

main-sca-scan:
  extends: .sca-scan
  dependencies:
    - main-prep
    - main-build
  except:
    - merge_requests

mr-sca-scan:
  extends: .sca-scan
  dependencies:
    - mr-prep
    - mr-build-test
  only:
    - merge_requests

sync-jiras:
  stage: sync-jiras
  extends: .buildjob
  dependencies:
    - main-prep
    - main-build
    - main-test
  rules: *if_pipeline
  script:
    - *npmrc
    # Do npm install if node_modules was not found in cache
    - *npm_install
    - *aws_access
    # Create necessary jira tickets
    - npx ts-node ./node_modules/@ps-refarch/veracode-static/scripts/jira-sync.ts
```

## Other build systems

It shouldn't be too hard to build Good luck! 

# Set pipeline variables

Add the following pipeline variables to your CI system:

| Variable | Value |
|----------|-------|
|JIRA_USERNAME|the PowerSchool email of the shared mailbox user in jira|
|JIRA_PASSWORD|the Jira API access token|
|JIRA_EPIC|Jira epic to add tickets under, e.g. NFR-779|
|JIRA_PROJECT|Jira project to create tickets under, e.g. NFR|

# Ignored files

By default, the scanner ignores the normal NodeJS project files, both in the root and in sub-directories. You can also supplement this with extra ignored patterns by creating a `.veracodeignore` file in the root folder of your project. Like other ignore files, it is a list of file glob patterns that are ignored. Blank lines and lines starting with a comment character `#` are ignored. Note that the `!` syntax - to include files otherwise ignore - is not currently supported. Here's an example:

```
# Scripts are build-time only
**/scripts/*
```

Put in these terms, the default set of ignored files (augmented, not replaced by `.veracodeignore`) are:

```
.git/*
node_modules/*
**/node_modules/*
**/dist/*
**/ui/dist/*
**/cdk.out/*
**/coverage/*
**/test/*
**/__tests__/*
```
